note: Hand-stated bindings, read by scripts/build-binding.mjs and merged into binding.json. Edit this; never edit binding.json. Needed where our map sheets are drawn finer than the game's areas: the matcher assigns one sheet per area, so sibling sheets of a shared area are left with nothing to claim and no way to guess correctly between them.

floors._comment: our floor id -> the game rooms that sheet actually covers. The area is derived from the rooms, and the check pool is narrowed to exactly these rooms rather than the whole area.

markers._comment: our marker id -> canonical entrance id.

missingMarkers._comment: Doors the game has that our sheets do not draw yet, with where they belong. scripts/audit-doors.mjs finds these; this records what to do about them. Empty is the goal.

todo._comment: Open questions that need checking in the game itself, because the data cannot settle them.
todo.m280 Spencers Place / After Using Me - E: Sits 0.44 tiles from e152, Spencer Cave Unplug - Exit to Overworld, which the randomizer has no link for and so never shuffles. Two readings: it is the same physical door as m278 on the Inside sheet, which the randomizer models once as e151 and which would make this marker a duplicate to delete like the Level Forest exit; or it is a genuine second way out that the randomizer folds into the first. Needs checking in game.

reasoning.40103 Aquaria / Inn: Is the Aquaria INN, room 44 — the far side of m171 Winter INN Entrance. It had been handed the Aquaria Summer area, which is not an interior at all but the thawed town itself, and its one door was renamed after a Spencer's Place entrance on the strength of that.
reasoning.40105 Aquaria / Northwest House Warp Roo: Is the Aquaria Gemini Room, room 43, reached by the Vendor House stairs. The room has exactly two entrances, so once m187 takes the stairs back up (e97) the Crest is forced: m188 is e96, the Gemini tile to Fireburg's Gemini Room.
reasoning.40501 Spencers Place / Passage: Is the Spencer Waterfall, room 71. Both its doors fit at one offset of about (26, 0.5) to within a fifth of a tile — Entrance is the Aquaria side (e148) and Exit drops into the cave (e143) — where the binding it came up with had Exit on the Aquaria side and an offset that fits neither.
reasoning.174 Aquaria / Unfrozen Aquaria - Spencer: e90, the Summer-side door to Spencer's Place. Geometry cannot reach this one: our single town sheet serves both the game's Winter and Summer areas, which have different origins, so this marker sits 30 tiles from either candidate. It is settled instead by its far side — m275 is e148, and e148 pairs with e90.
reasoning.192 Aquaria / Phoebe's House - Main Entr: e93, its own front door, pairing back to m173 in the town. Pinned because it does not stay put otherwise: freeing e89 when the Inn was corrected let this marker drift onto it, which in turn pushed e93 out to a Fireburg sheet. One wrong binding moving makes its neighbours move.
reasoning.Fireburg houses (50102, 50103, 50105-501: Named on our maps for where they sit in town and in the game for what they are, so nothing matched: Southwest House is the Vendor House (room 80), Southwest House Warp is the Gemini Room (81), Arion's Friend's House is GrenadeMan's House (78), its Warp is the Mobius Room (79), Hotel is the Hotel Lobby (82) and Hotel Second Floor is the Beds (83). Each sheet's two doors fit its room at one shared offset to within a quarter tile, where swapping them lands 4 to 28 tiles out — so which door is which is not a guess either.
reasoning.40206 and 40207 Ice Pyramid: These two sheets were swapped. Fifth Floor - Area 2 is the Ice Golem Room (room 70) and First Basement - Area 1 is the B1 Taunt Room (room 53), not the reverse: our sheets carry one chest and three-boxes-and-a-chest respectively, and those rooms carry exactly that, the other way round from how they were bound. Inside Ice Pyramid the name test is no help — every sheet shares "ice pyramid" with every area — so geometry decided it alone and got these two the wrong way round. Their doors follow: m246 is e141 and m251 is e113.
reasoning.40402 Wintry Cave / Second Floor: Its two doors are named the wrong way round: To 3F Bottom is the way back down to 1F (e104) and Exit is the one to 3F Bottom (e103). That assignment fits both markers at one offset to within 0.14 of a tile, where the names as written land 47 tiles out. Renamed to match.
reasoning.40403 Wintry Cave / Third Floor: One sheet for the game's two areas, 3F Top (room 49) and 3F Bottom (room 50), which have different origins — so no single offset fits both doors and geometry cannot settle them. Exit from 3F Top is e105, back to 1F; Entrance 2 is e106, the way down to 2F, which is the far side of m269.
reasoning.Windia houses (60103-60111): The game keeps every Windia interior in one area of seven rooms while we draw a sheet per room, so only one sheet could ever claim it and the rest went unbound or drifted onto Pazuzu and Mac's Ship. Named by what each sheet contains: Inn is the Inn Lobby (163), Inn Second Floor the Beds (164, two boxes), House Near Entrance the Vendor House (165), House Above Inn the Old People House (160), House Above Inn Warp its Basement (162, two boxes), Small House Upper Left the Kid House (159), Small House Warp the Kid House Basement (161), Otto's House room 157 and Otto's House Second Floor the Attic (158, one box). Every two-door sheet fits its room at one offset within 0.4 of a tile, against 4.6 to 19.9 for the alternative, so the doors are not guesses either.
reasoning.Alive Forest (60203) and its tree stumps: The Giant Tree door position you gave, 682,682, is tile 42,42, which fixes the sheet's offset at (-0.625, -0.625) — and on that offset every crest lands within a couple of pixels of an entrance, so which crest is which is settled: 393,171 is Mobius, 920,793 is Gemini, 133,838 is Libra. The Giant Tree door was missing because m743 sat exactly on top of m461, a copy that never got moved, leaving five markers on four spots; m743 was moved to 682,682 rather than adding a sixth. The stumps are the Foresta treehouses in the game's data — Libra is room 21, Gemini 22, Mobius 23 — which is why they had drifted onto Pazuzu and Mac's Ship.
reasoning.40601 Libra Temple / Inside: Its two doors were swapped: the upper one (m286) is the Libra crest tile to Life Temple (e76) and the lower one (m287) is the door to the overworld (e75). Both markers land within 0.15 tiles of those entrances at a shared offset of about (0.5, 0.5), where the binding it came up with fits one marker and misses the other by seven tiles. It went wrong because align() buckets offsets by rounding, and a true offset sitting on the .5 boundary rounds the two correct pairings into different buckets, so neither ever gathers a second vote and a coincidence wins on the tie-break.
